question: What status belongs to the one who knows and observes the vow?
premises: One may know and be observant of the vow.
Such a person is identified as Kaula.
The Goddess is addressed as Shambhavi.
inference: The knower who observes the vow is affirmed to be a Kaula practitioner.
uncertainties: The token cāpi appears again as a separate token in the list; its repetition may be emphatic or textual.
plain_english: O Shambhavi, he who knows and observes the vow would be a Kaula practitioner as well.
